inputs.text: Based on newly filed court documents, lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. This revelation came to light in a lawsuit that challenges the practice of targeting individuals seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. Furthermore, federal prosecutors stated that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year did not authorize the arrests, even though they had previously cited that same memo to justify them.
